item.title: What we know about the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire
item.description: A 10-day truce between the two countries has been extended by three weeks after talks in Washington.

item.title: Some Iranians fear the regime is now more entrenched - and ready for revenge
item.description: Ordinary Iranians tell of worry about increased repression by authorities after the war is over.

item.title: Israeli police arrest man after nun attacked in Jerusalem
item.description: The French nun was pushed over and kicked in the apparently unprovoked assault, amid a rise in harassment of Christians in the city by Jewish extremists.

item.title: Israeli 'double-tap' strike kills three rescue workers in Lebanon, officials say
item.description: They are among nine people killed in successive attacks on Tuesday, which Israel's military says targeted a Hezbollah commander.

item.title: United Arab Emirates to quit oil cartel Opec
item.description: The UAE's decision, after nearly 60 years of membership, is seen as a potential death knell for the oil cartel.

item.title: Faisal Islam: Why the UAE's exit from Opec is a big deal
item.description: It will have little effect on the current oil blockades, but it could change everything afterwards.

item.title: Israel releases all but two activists in Greece after intercepting Gaza aid flotilla
item.description: The Global Sumud Flotilla denounced the interception as "piracy", while Israel's foreign ministry called the flotilla a "PR stunt".

item.title: Syria trial seen as first step on long road for Assad's victims
item.description: There were highly charged scenes as former senior regime official, Atef Najib, appeared before a Damascus court.

item.title: Who is making decisions in Iran?
item.description: Iran's new supreme leader is supposed to have the final say, but in practice the picture is far murkier.

item.title: Couple discovers Lebanon home destroyed by Israel from satellite image
item.description: Joe Elias contacted BBC Verify following reports that his village was among several destroyed by Israeli forces.
